title: cyclanthera hastata
intro: Cyclanthera hastata, commonly known as the snake gourd or snake melon, is a type of vining plant in the Cucurbitaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cyclanthera hastata are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cucurbitacins, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
